messages:
Matt H: FYI seeing a big spike in OOB/KVM connections from prov-runner into us-central1-a. GPU nodes are getting evicted because jump-hosts hit connection limits.
ops-bot: ALERT: ipmi-session-fanout detected on rack-rg4 (us-central1-a) 13 ~2.1k concurrent sessions, kvm-proxy pool saturated :rotating_light:
Sara P: Did a firmware batch go out last night? microcode/BIOS/BMC changes could explain an agent churn.
Matt H: Yes, we pushed microcode v2.1.4 to ~60% of us-central around 02:00 UTC. Early signs show BMC agent restarts and repeated KVM reauths.
Kevin L: Can you share the conn table snapshot?
Matt H: Snippet from jump-hosts:
```
# ss -tnp | grep kvm-proxy | wc -l
2100
# ss -tnp | grep 10.10.42. | head -n5
ESTAB 0 0 10.10.42.12:623 10.0.1.4:51022 users:("kvm-proxy",pid=442)
ESTAB 0 0 10.10.42.13:623 10.0.1.4:51023 users:("kvm-proxy",pid=442)
...
```
Lina (oncall): If jump-host conn pool is at capacity prov-runner will retry and trigger mass reprovisioning. We need an immediate throttle and rollback.
Sara P: Agreed. Pause the rollout, throttle provisioning, and start rollback on impacted racks. Also flag cost impact.
Matt H: Rolling back rack-rg4 to v2.1.3 now. Initiating rollback job.
deploy-bot: rollback-job/1717801111 started 13 targets: rack-rg4 (38 hosts) :rocket:
Kevin L: Short-term mitigations: cap max_conn on the ipmi proxy, bump BMC keepalive 10s->60s to avoid reconnection storms, and add per-source rate limits on jump-hosts. I'll open CL (PR #1287).
Lina (oncall): Throttling prov concurrency: `provctl throttle --rack rack-rg4 --concurrency 2`
Matt H: provctl applied. Conn count dropping to ~700, GPU evictions decreasing.
Sara P: Cost estimate: roughly $8k in extra reprovisioning + preemptible churn over the past 3.5 hours. Logging billing impact in incident.
Matt H: Likely root cause: microcode flash toggled UEFI secureboot attribute intermittently, which made the management agent restart and renegotiate sessions. Need vendor confirmation.
Lina (oncall): If rollback doesn't stabilize within 30m I'll escalate to vendor P0. Also propose gating future BMC/microcode pushes with a 5-host canary and an automated keepalive check.
Kevin L: I'll add a preflight: simulate BMC restart, validate session stability for 5m, and add a rate-limit parameter to rollout orchestration. PR queued.
Matt H: Charts looking better. @eng-infra please avoid touching BMC images in us-central until validation completes. :exclamation:
Sara P: I'm updating the runbook: how to read jump-host conn tables, provctl commands, and rollback procedure.
Lina (oncall): Monitoring for 1hr. If anything regresses we'll open a postmortem.
Kevin L: Filed follow-ups: tool changes, vendor repro steps, and cost-tagging for firmware rollouts.
Matt H: Rollback finished on rack-rg4 at +18m; GPU pool is back to healthy. Continuing slow canary across us-central.
ops-bot: RESOLVED: ipmi-session-fanout on rack-rg4 13 connections below threshold.
Sara P: Nice work. Action items: add session caps on jump-hosts and attach a billing tag to firmware rollout jobs so cost hits are traceable.
Lina (oncall): Copy. Adding to oncall checklist.
Matt H: Thanks team 13 I'll follow up with the postmortem and vendor ticket link.
